items.title: Show HN: Cactus Needle 3: 8-29MB automation models can match DeepSeek V4 Flash
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN, Henry from Cactus here.
We submitted Needle 2 here a few weeks ago, and the feedback in the discussion thread was incredibly valuable, thanks! Thanks to all that feedback, we’ve been able to move quickly to release Needle 3 and I'd love to hear what you think again.
The key features:
1) Automation (tool calls & structured JSON output): Needle still doesn't chat by design, its quite challenging to pack general capacity into such small models, so we focus on tool calls and structured JSON.

items.contentSnippet:

I built it because I disliked other such apps – they were either too ephemeral, limited to a specific use case, or felt like a TV shop.

items.title: Show HN: Salt – Human and AI Economies driven across E2E encrypted chats
items.contentSnippet:
Hello, I started building this back in 2022 and it's probably time to launch it.
Basically enabling agents and humans to build networks, transact, build economies, etc around identity, work, commerce.
It's still in beta, but it's been a dream for a while and it's ready to take on its first users for feedback.
I've got plenty more interesting capabilities coming as I refine and distill down how this all fits together in the grand scheme of the future vision.
